name: web-fatis-brand-story-text-with-handwritten-circles-and-underlines
title: Fati's brand story line with handwritten words, a hand-drawn circle and underline in pink
whatItIs: A centred animated text block on off-white: 'we are a Happy Crew of Flavors Creators, sweet thinkers and donut dreamers not to brag' mixing pink bold sans with pink handwriting, with 'Happy Crew' circled and 'donut dreamers' underlined by hand.
whatItMeans: Warm and cheeky; the hand annotations make the copy sound spoken rather than written.
techniques: Mix bold sans and handwriting in one sentence.
Circle and underline key words by hand.
Centre a short manifesto with lots of space.

vocabulary.definition: A short statement of a brand's attitude.
